name: awards-footer.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  awards-footer.scss — the dark footer band shared by Home/About/Legal:
//  awards/mentions auto-carousel (with the progress ring) + legal links row.
//  Layout: %MAXAREA content column inside a --bg-dark full-bleed band.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/fonts';
@import '../../base/placeholders';
@import '../../base/structure';

// Shadow host — dark footer band surface.
:host {
  @extend %SKEL_DARK_SURFACE;

  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
}

// ── Awards footer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Shared across Home, About, and Legal pages.
// Dark background (same as .contact), centred layout.
.awards-footer {
  @extend %MAXAREA;

  background: var(--bg-dark);
  color: var(--color-white-raw);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding-top: to-rem($space-2xl);
  padding-bottom: to-rem($space-3xl);

  @include layout-768() {
    padding-top: to-rem($space-2xl);
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-3xl);
  }
  @include layout-2560() {
    padding-top: to-rem($space-3xl);
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-4xl);
  }

  &-title {
    @extend .ttl-sm;

    font-weight: 100;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--color-white-raw);
    text-align: center;
    padding: to-rem($space-md) 0 to-rem($space-lg);
    opacity: 0.85;
  }

  // Limit carousel width — centred max width so it feels compact
  .aw-c--awards {
    max-width: to-rem($space-8xl);
    width: 100%;
  }

  &-skel {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    padding: to-rem($space-xl) 0;
    min-height: to-rem($space-5xl);
  }

  // Legal links — divider + footer links, constrained to grid
  &-links {
    @extend .ttl-xs;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    color: var(--color-white-raw);
    width: 100%;
    padding: to-rem($space-lg) 0 0;
    border-top: to-rem($space-hairline) solid var(--border-color);
    margin: to-rem($space-xl) auto 0;

    &-item {
      @extend .ttl-xs;
      @extend %LK_LINK;

      color: var(--color-white-raw);
      text-decoration: none;
      // Home-footer legal links (Privacy, LGPD, Terms) rest without an
      // underline; the LK_LINK pseudo-element still sweeps in on hover.
      border-bottom-color: transparent;
      // The %LK_LINK underline is a border-bottom — keep the line box tight
      // so it hugs the baseline like a real underline, and carry the row
      // spacing on margins instead of an inflated line-height.
      margin-block: to-rem($space-md);
      line-height: to-rem($space-xl);
      opacity: 0.85;
      transition:
        opacity 0.2s,
        border-bottom-color 0.3s ease;

      &:hover,
      &:focus {
        opacity: 1;
      }

      &.router-link-active {
        opacity: 1;
        border-bottom-color: var(--color-accent);
      }
    }

    &-sep {
      padding: 0 to-rem($space-md);
      font-weight: 200;
      opacity: 0.6;
      color: var(--color-white-raw);
    }
  }
}

// ── Awards header + time-based progress bar ───────────────────────────────────
// The .aw-ft-header wrapper is display:inline-flex so the progress
// track is naturally capped to the width of the "SOME MENTIONS" h2 text.
// Progress is driven by a CSS @keyframes animation (0→100% over the carousel
// duration) restarted on each slidechange — no JS width calculation needed.

$_B_AFH: 'awards-footer-header';
$_B_AFP: 'awards-footer-progress';

@keyframes awards-progress-fill {
  from {
    transform: scaleX(0);
  }
  to {
    transform: scaleX(1);
  }
}

// Awards footer header row.
.#{$_B_AFH} {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  margin-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
}

// Circular progress ring for the auto-advance.
.#{$_B_AFP} {
  width: 100%;
  height: to-rem($space-2xs);
  background: var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: to-rem($space-2xs);
  opacity: 0.75;
  transition: opacity 0.4s ease;

  &--hidden {
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
}

// The animated progress ring fill (SVG stroke-dashoffset).
.#{$_B_AFP}-fill {
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left;
  background: var(--color-accent);
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  will-change: transform;

  // Driven by JS: class is removed + re-added after a forced reflow to restart
  &--running {
    animation: awards-progress-fill var(--progress-duration, 10s) linear forwards;
  }
}

// ── Source code row ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Centered mini-line at the very bottom of every footer that bears it.

// Divider sheen — mirrors internal-footer-divider-sheen; defined per
// stylesheet because shadow roots scope keyframes. The band is an ::after
// swept with translateX so the loop stays on the compositor — animating
// background-position repaints the hairline every frame.
@keyframes footer-source-divider-sheen {
  from {
    transform: translateX(-110%);
  }

  to {
    transform: translateX(440%);
  }
}

// Credits/source line.
.footer-source {
  @extend .ttl-xs;

  text-transform: uppercase;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
  width: 100%;
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: to-rem($space-lg);
  color: var(--color-white-raw);
  // 0.7 keeps the muted look while staying above the 4.5:1 contrast floor
  // on --bg-dark in both themes
  opacity: 0.7;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: to-rem($space-lg);

  &-link {
    @extend .ttl-xs;
    @extend %LK_LINK;

    color: var(--color-white-raw);
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    border-bottom-color: currentColor;

    &::after {
      transform: scaleX(1);
    }
  }

  // Docs-portal entry — sits above the source credit: English link title
  // + localized "Available only in English" note, centered mini-line.
  &-docs {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
    width: 100%;
    text-align: center;
    margin: to-rem($space-2xl) 0 0;
    color: var(--color-white-raw);
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);

    &-link {
      @extend %LK_LINK;

      color: var(--color-white-raw);
      text-decoration: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      opacity: 0.85;
      border-bottom-color: currentColor;
      transition:
        opacity 0.2s ease,
        border-bottom-color 0.3s ease;

      &::after {
        transform: scaleX(1);
      }

      &:hover,
      &:focus {
        opacity: 1;
      }
    }

    &-desc {
      // Muted while staying above the 4.5:1 contrast floor on --bg-dark.
      opacity: 0.7;
    }
  }

  // Animated hairline between the source row and the authorship block —
  // same sheen pattern as .internal-footer-items-divider: a soft accent
  // streak travels the line on a slow loop.
  &-divider {
    display: block;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    width: 100%;
    height: to-rem($space-3xs);
    // Generous air above (≈120px requested → closest Fibonacci step is
    // $space-5xl/144px) and a tight 21px gap under the authorship lines.
    margin: to-rem($space-5xl) auto to-rem($space-xl);
    padding: 0;
    border: none;
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    // Static hairline — the traveling accent band lives on ::after so the
    // sweep is a composited transform, not a per-frame background repaint.
    background: linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent,
      var(--border-color) 12%,
      var(--border-color) 88%,
      transparent
    );

    &::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 25%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--color-accent) 50%, transparent);
      transform: translateX(-110%);
      animation: footer-source-divider-sheen 7s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      &::after {
        animation: none;
      }
    }

    // Shadow DOM: the store-driven html.reduced-motion flag can't pierce
    // the boundary — host-context mirrors the media query.
    :host-context(html.reduced-motion) & {
      &::after {
        animation: none;
      }
    }
  }

  // Authorship lines — centered mini copy under the divider. Both lines
  // keep the .footer-source muted treatment (0.7 stays above the 4.5:1
  // floor on --bg-dark); the credit wraps, the rights line stays short.
  &-credit,
  &-rights {
    @extend .ttl-xxs;

    width: 100%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    text-align: center;
    color: var(--color-white-raw);
    opacity: 0.7;
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: to-rem($space-xl);
    // The authorship lines read as a quiet colophon, not small caps —
    // drop %TTL_XXS's uppercase and set the copy in italic instead.
    text-transform: none;
    font-style: italic;
  }

  &-credit {
    max-width: to-rem($space-9xl);
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-md);
  }
}
